Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, detecting 153 matching passages distributed across 31 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The highest concentration of shared text occurs in the commentaries to the *Theragāthā* and *Therīgāthā*, as well as in the *Rasavāhinī* [DharmaNexus]. In addition, segments §6–§10 exhibit substantial formulaic overlap with other poems within the Therāpadāna collection, most prominently the *Sucintitattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 430), the *Naḷakuṭidāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 501), and the *Dhajadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 345) [DharmaNexus].
